# Glossary

Definitions for domain terms used throughout the codebase and documentation.

---

**Access Token** — Short-lived JWT (default: 15 min) used to authenticate API requests. Sent
in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

**Achievement** — A milestone that awards XP and a badge when a player meets a defined criterion
(e.g. "Complete 3 levels in a row"). Stored in the `Achievement` model; awarded by the
execution worker after a successful submission.

**AI Hint** — An on-demand hint generated by a large language model (Groq, `llama-3.3-70b-versatile`)
specific to the player's current code and error message. Rate-limited to 20 per 24 h per user.

**Biome** — The visual theme and NPC character set of a 3D escape room chamber. Determined
from the world slug: javascript → cyber, typescript → ice, rust/cpp → lava, go → space,
python/java → forest.

**Challenge** — A coding problem with a statement, test cases, hints, and a starter code
template in one or more languages. Identified by a stable `slug`.

**ChallengeType** — Enum describing how the challenge is solved: `ALGORITHMS`, `DATA_STRUCTURES`,
`DEBUGGING`, `OUTPUT_PREDICTION`, `FILL_IN_THE_BLANK`, `CODE_COMPLETION`.

**Code-runner** — The isolated HTTP service (`apps/code-runner`) that receives an
`ExecutionRequest` and executes the code inside a Docker sandbox. Never directly accessible
to players.

**ContainerWatchdog** — The outer timeout in `sandbox.ts` that kills a hung `docker run`
process. Computed as `timeLimitMs + 10 s (startup) + 20 s (compile)`, clamped to [30 s, 120 s].

**Daily Reward** — A login streak reward that grants XP and coins once per calendar day.

**Difficulty** — A 1–5 integer on `GameWorld` and `GameLevel` indicating the skill level
expected of the player. Not the same as `ChallengeDifficulty` (EASY / MEDIUM / HARD).

**Duel** — A real-time head-to-head match where two players solve the same challenge. The
winner is determined by score (test cases passed × time bonus), not first submission.

**EscapeRoom3D** — The React Three Fiber 3D room component. Split into four files:
`EscapeRoom3D.tsx` (main), `-characters.tsx`, `-environments.tsx`, `-helpers.tsx`.

**Execution Worker** — The background process (`dist/worker.js`) that drains the Redis
execution queue and calls the code-runner. Runs as the `worker` service in docker-compose.

**GameLevel** — One room/puzzle inside a `GameWorld`. Has a `number` (1-based within the
world), optional `challengeId`, and a `RoomLock` if it is gated.

**GameWorld** — A themed progression world containing 3 levels. Players unlock worlds by
accumulating enough XP. Each world has a `slug` (e.g. `python-forest`).

**GROQ_API_KEY** — Environment variable required for AI hints. If absent or empty, AI hint
generation is disabled but all other features continue to work.

**isRedisReady** — A utility function in `apps/server/src/shared/lib/redis.ts` that returns
`true` only if the Redis client is in the `ready` state. Used to guard queue operations
and fail fast rather than buffer indefinitely.

**Judge** — The process of comparing a submission's runtime output against all test cases
and computing the final `status` (ACCEPTED, WRONG_ANSWER, etc.). Runs inside the worker.

**Level** — See `GameLevel`.

**Lock** — See `RoomLock`.

**MonacoCodeEditor** — The Monaco-based (VSCode engine) code editor component used on the
challenge player page.

**Player** — Any authenticated user with the `PLAYER` role (the default role).

**Prisma** — The ORM used for all database access. The schema lives in
`database/prisma/schema.prisma` (48 models).

**Rate Limit** — Per-IP or per-user request throttling implemented with `RedisRateLimitStore`.
Falls back to in-process counters if Redis is unavailable.

**Refresh Token** — Long-lived token (default: 30 days) that can exchange for a new access token.
Stored as a bcrypt hash; invalidated on logout.

**RoomConfig** — The 2D layout data for a room: theme colours, obstacle positions, object
positions. Defined in `room-config.ts`; resolved by key `${worldSlug}:${levelNumber}`.

**RoomKey** — An inventory item awarded when a player completes a level. Stored in
`PlayerRoomKey`. Required to unlock a `RoomLock` on a higher level.

**RoomLock** — A gate on a `GameLevel` that requires a specific `RoomKey` to open. Represents
the "locked door" mechanic in the escape room.

**Sandbox** — The ephemeral Docker container that executes untrusted code. Launched by the
code-runner with `--cap-drop ALL`, `--network none`, `--user 65534:65534`, and other
isolation flags. See `docs/Security.md` for the full flag list.

**SceneState** — The saved 3D room state (player position, unlocked objects) persisted via
the scenes API. Restored when a player re-enters a room.

**Seed** — An idempotent database script that populates initial content (worlds, challenges,
achievements). Run once after migrations on a fresh database.

**Slug** — A URL-safe, stable string identifier (e.g. `python-forest`, `python-sum-two-numbers`).
Used instead of UUIDs in client-facing URLs.

**Status** — The outcome of a submission: `QUEUED`, `RUNNING`, `ACCEPTED`, `WRONG_ANSWER`,
`COMPILATION_ERROR`, `RUNTIME_ERROR`, `TIME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`, `MEMORY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`,
`INTERNAL_ERROR`.

**Submission** — A player's attempt at a challenge. Stored in the `Submission` model.
Processing is async: the worker picks it up from the Redis queue and writes the final status.

**Telemetry** — Consent-gated engagement signals (e.g. `level_complete`, `hint_reveal`).
Off by default. Raw events are pruned after 90 days.

**Theme** — The colour palette and CSS gradients for a 2D room. Defined as `RoomTheme` in
`room-config.ts`.

**Turborepo** — The monorepo build orchestrator. Configured in `turbo.json`; caches build
artefacts across packages.

**World** — See `GameWorld`.

**XP** — Experience points awarded for completing levels, claiming daily rewards, etc. Used
to unlock new worlds (`GameWorld.requiredXp`) and track progression on the leaderboard.
